credits.title: The Devil Knows Your Name
credits.overview: Mariel and Tino, a documentary filmmaking duo specializing in disturbing crimes, investigate a tragedy that occurred a year earlier at a care home, where a young volunteer named Gisela set fire to a dormitory with several children inside. credits.title: Satanascabaña
credits.overview: A group of friends travels to a cabin to celebrate Citlali’s birthday, but she never arrives. Instead, Fernando—a friend of hers whom no one knows—shows up.

credits.title: I Am Mario
credits.overview: Mario is a trans taxi driver who gets pregnant. He has the possibility of fulfilling his desire to become a father, but this confronts him with his expectations regarding his masculinity. Before exposing himself to a "macho" and prejudice-filled society, he must face himself.

credits.title: Mexican Psycho
credits.overview: Follows an "ultra-violent and intelligent" psychopath who challenges the police by leaving a white paper rabbit at each crime scene, connecting them all.

credits.title: The Silent Virgin
credits.overview: Valeria lives trapped under her mother's control and the routine of her job at a court in Mexico City. Her life changes radically when she meets Tania, who will lead her to challenge her mother's authority and the injustices surrounding her.

credits.title: Woman Who Lives at the End of Time
credits.overview: Year 2030. A queer human rights lawyer and leader of a Mexico City feminist collective under threat is visited by a mysterious stranger seeking refuge and whose story is in doubt.

credits.title: Maybe I'll Find You in a Robbery
credits.overview: A little girl devises an innovative scheme to reconnect with her imprisoned mother during Christmas.

credits.title: La eterna adolescente
credits.overview: Gema’s suicide attempt brings her three children together after many years, on the eve of an unusually cold Christmas in Guadalajara. credits.title: Goya
credits.overview: Cesar and his brother Mateo only have a few days left before their life together changes dramatically. What was meant to be a fun farewell turns into a pursuit to liberate Goya, a friend in need.

credits.title: Corina
credits.overview: Corina is 20 years old and does not leave her house except to work in a publishing house located in the neighborhood where she lives. credits.title: Elevation
credits.overview: Fugazi, a depressed girl, and Samuel, a boy looking for his missing brother, spend their days watching their city being taken by the army. Meanwhile, an uprising is growing on the streets…

credits.title: The First Gift
credits.overview: A young couple, Lucas and Manu, await the arrival of their baby in an old apartment. As the birth approaches, Manu will realize that there is a presence in the building that is waiting for her baby as much or more than she is.

credits.title: Martínez
credits.overview: Martinez, an embittered Chilean in his sixties who has lived in Mexico for the past 40 years and is being forced to retire from his job. As he struggles with life changes, a neighbor suddenly dies and as he sifts through her diary and her things, he begins to live vicariously through her and find new meaning in life.

credits.title: DIVE
credits.overview: Mariel is a veteran elite diver who has one last chance at the Olympic Games. However, when a terrible truth comes to light, Mariel faces her biggest personal question: Is winning her true dream?

credits.title: De la nada
credits.overview: Susana meets Angel, they hit it off, they like each other, they make a good match. But everything crumbles when Angel begins to disappear, like a ghost.

credits.title: ¡Basta!
credits.overview: A young couple tries to make each other jealous while playing a  simple board game. Secretly, an older neighbor listens and  reflects on his own love life.

credits.title: Lessons on the Improper Use of Objects
credits.overview: Three objects are used in a manner in which they weren't supposed to be. Something unprecedented happens: armed with a voice and conscience, these objects will reflect on the absurd arguments that support domestic violence.

credits.title: The Farewells
credits.overview: At Miguel's farewell party, Laura, his girlfriend, and Eduardo, his best friend, face their fears and loneliness. As the night goes on, emotions run high, pushing them to risk what they desire, though not all will find what they expect.

credits.title: Wintersong
credits.overview: Danielle, a young musician, sets off on a journey with Diego, her best friend, while both of them face the pain of breaking-up with their partners. Ending up at the north border of Mexico, they’ll have to use their abilities as musicians to survive as they get to know the complicated context between the US and Mexico.

credits.title: Run Away
credits.overview: Juan, a young Latin American student, is forced to run away after witnessing the enforced disappearance of his best friends in Mexico.

credits.title: El Clásico
credits.overview: The tumultuous journey of two friends to a soccer stadium, hands them a new perspective of their friendship, their morals, and Mexico City.

credits.title: Shit Day
credits.overview: Jesús wakes up at his best friend's house without remembering anything about the night before. While he survives and conceals his infinite hangover, he will have to deal with the professional and personal successes of friends and strangers, as well as face obvious failure in the near future.

credits.title: Fractal
credits.overview: On a gloomy Sunday in Mexico City, three friends in their twenties look for a female friend that disappears at an after-party. credits.title: Intruder
credits.overview: A young filmmaker has a hard time finishing his script. In it tells the story of a toxic couple, their tragic separation, and a bloody hunt about to begin.

credits.title: Diabla
credits.overview: After surviving assault, an enigmatic 17-year-old Mexican girl finds retribution through her untapped female power and local witch culture.

credits.title: Angst & Flesh
credits.overview: Elena loves Abel, she is drowning on the anguish of being, her subconscious manifests her urges; during the funeral misfortune sets in. Laceration and calm, devotion and fear, angst and flesh.

credits.title: Martian Chronicle
credits.overview: After the colonization of Mars, an elderly man looks back on his memories of Earth and the past he has left behind.

credits.title: The Untamed
credits.overview: A meteorite deposits an alien monster with strange powers near the home of an unhappy couple.

credits.title: Mariachi Nights
credits.overview: Four young athletes escape to tour the streets of Guadalajara by night.
